description: This file defines a Python class SlackV2Notification that handles sending Slack notifications for reports using the Slack API, including methods for retrieving channels, inline files, and sending messages with error handling.

classes.name: SlackV2Notification
classes.description: A class that sends Slack notifications for report recipients using Slack API v2, with methods for retrieving channels, inline files, and sending messages with error handling.

methods.name: _get_channels
methods.description: Retrieves the list of Slack channels from the recipient configuration JSON.

methods.name: _get_inline_files
methods.description: Determines and returns the inline files (CSV, screenshots, PDF) to be uploaded with the notification.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the Slack notification, uploading files or posting messages, with error handling and retries.
